verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own realm import/export as JSON, including operator-automated realm import, creates or exports many users, clients and roles in one operation. The Admin CLI (kcadm.sh) and Admin REST API support scripted administration. Community reports confirm initial realm JSON loads work, but say keeping later changes in sync is hard and that admin API inconsistencies hamper idempotent automation. Missing for 10: documented bulk-action endpoints or UI for editing, deleting or updating many existing items at once; SCIM bulk-operation support; hands-on evidence of bulk updates at scale.
